input.command: wc -l README.md && grep -n '^#' README.md && grep -n -i 'tune' README.md; ls; ls .markdown-lint-on-edit CHANGE-VALIDATION.md DRIFT-CHECK.md 2>&1
ls yf/src yf/src/* | head -80; grep -rn -i 'tune' yf/src --include=*.rs -l | head -30
ls yf/src/cmd/harness; grep -n -i 'tune' yf/src/cli.rs | head -60; ls target/*/yf 2>/dev/null; which yf; yf --version

grep -n 'yes\|auto.detect\|detect_harness\|harness.is_empty\|is_empty()' yf/src/cmd/harness/mod.rs | head -40; grep -rn '\.yf/' yf/src/cmd/harness/manifest.rs | head -10; grep -n 'SPEC\|tune' SPEC.md | grep -n 'REQ-YF-TUNE-0\(12\|22\|23\)' | head
